Date picker

Source: R/tier2-calendar.R
shad_date_picker.Rd

A shadcn date picker: a trigger button that opens a shad_calendar() in a popover. Value contract is identical to shad_calendar().

Usage

shad_date_picker(
  inputId,
  label = NULL,
  value = NULL,
  mode = c("single", "range"),
  placeholder = "Pick a date",
  min = NULL,
  max = NULL,
  presets = NULL,
  caption_layout = c("label", "dropdown", "dropdown-months", "dropdown-years"),
  year_range = NULL,
  disabled = FALSE,
  width = NULL,
  class = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

inputId

Input id.

label

Optional label (wraps in shad_form_field()).

value

Initial selection: a Date/character (single) or length-2 Date/character (range).

mode

"single" (default) or "range".

placeholder

Trigger text shown when nothing is selected.

min, max

Selectable bounds (inclusive), Date/character.

presets

Optional quick-range rail, only valid with mode = "range". A named list; names are the button labels and each value is either a keyword ("today", "yesterday", "this-week", "this-month", "last-month", "this-year"), an integer N meaning the last N days, or a length-2 Date vector giving an explicit start and end. shad_date_presets() returns a ready-made set.

caption_layout

Header style: "label" (default, month and year as text), "dropdown" (both as selects), "dropdown-months" or "dropdown-years". Use a dropdown when the user has to travel years, such as a date of birth.

year_range

Length-2 numeric bounding the year dropdown, e.g. c(1900, 2025). Defaults to the years of min/max when given, otherwise 100 years back and 10 forward.

disabled

If TRUE, disables the control.

width

CSS width.

class

Extra CSS classes.

...

Extra attributes on the calendar root.

Value

A date-picker tag.

See also

Other shadshiny tier-2 components: shad_calendar(), shad_checkbox(), shad_combobox(), shad_date_presets(), shad_form_field(), shad_input(), shad_input_group(), shad_input_otp(), shad_native_select(), shad_radio_group(), shad_select(), shad_slider(), shad_switch(), shad_textarea(), shad_toggle(), shad_toggle_group()

Examples

shad_date_picker("d", label = "Date")
#> <div class="shad-form-field" data-shad="form-field">
#>   <label class="shad-label">Date</label>
#>   <div class="shad-date-picker" data-shad="date-picker" id="d">
#>     <button type="button" class="shad-date-picker__trigger" data-placeholder>
#>       <svg class="shad-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 2v4"/><path d="M16 2v4"/><rect width="18" height="18" x="3" y="4" rx="2"/><path d="M3 10h18"/></svg>
#>       <span class="shad-date-picker__value">Pick a date</span>
#>     </button>
#>     <div class="shad-date-picker__content shad-anim-pop" hidden>
#>       <div class="shad-calendar" data-shad="calendar" data-mode="single" data-week-start="0"></div>
#>     </div>
#>   </div>
#>   <p class="shad-form-field__error" hidden></p>
#> </div>
shad_date_picker("range", mode = "range")
#> <div class="shad-date-picker" data-shad="date-picker" id="range">
#>   <button type="button" class="shad-date-picker__trigger" data-placeholder>
#>     <svg class="shad-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 2v4"/><path d="M16 2v4"/><rect width="18" height="18" x="3" y="4" rx="2"/><path d="M3 10h18"/></svg>
#>     <span class="shad-date-picker__value">Pick a date</span>
#>   </button>
#>   <div class="shad-date-picker__content shad-anim-pop" hidden>
#>     <div class="shad-calendar" data-shad="calendar" data-mode="range" data-week-start="1"></div>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
shad_date_picker("dob", label = "Date of birth", caption_layout = "dropdown")
#> <div class="shad-form-field" data-shad="form-field">
#>   <label class="shad-label">Date of birth</label>
#>   <div class="shad-date-picker" data-shad="date-picker" id="dob">
#>     <button type="button" class="shad-date-picker__trigger" data-placeholder>
#>       <svg class="shad-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 2v4"/><path d="M16 2v4"/><rect width="18" height="18" x="3" y="4" rx="2"/><path d="M3 10h18"/></svg>
#>       <span class="shad-date-picker__value">Pick a date</span>
#>     </button>
#>     <div class="shad-date-picker__content shad-anim-pop" hidden>
#>       <div class="shad-calendar" data-shad="calendar" data-mode="single" data-week-start="0" data-caption-layout="dropdown"></div>
#>     </div>
#>   </div>
#>   <p class="shad-form-field__error" hidden></p>
#> </div>
